[SWS_DM_01113] Aging counter for combined events
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04200
⌈
If
DiagnosticCommonProps.typeOfEventCombinationSupported
is set to
eventCombinationOnStorage
, the DM shall calculate the aging counter based on
the combined DTC status.
⌋
7.3.4.1.3.2 Combination On Retrieval
For event combination on retrieval, the DM allocates the stored data per event in the
same way as if no event combination is used. The event combination is done on
data retrieval while reporting the
event
related data via UDS. The positive response
message for ReadDTCInformation contains the data of all stored events concatenated.
Thus, the length of the response message increases with each event that has stored
data for this DTC.
